_comment: Operationalizable NFR ceilings. The mixed-d10@380k rows anchor DESIGN_SPEC.md NFR #1 ('open a 5 MB JSON file without freezing the UI'): L1 parse + L1 build-tree + L3 paste-large each get a ceiling on the same fixture. Ceilings use `min(2 * measured median, 500ms)` rounded up to 50 ms, where 500ms is the Web Vitals INP 'poor' threshold (anchored on `docs/perf.md` 'Sentinel ceilings' section). The pre-F-2 stress-check row `3.paste-large.wide-aoo.1m` was removed (rather than ceiling-relaxed) because the 24 MB wide-aoo fixture exceeds Playwright's 10-min per-test timeout on the v1-reference machine (the #218 cross-iter cliff); the wide-aoo@1m baseline tracking is preserved by the missing-row contract in `scripts/perf/diff.mjs`.
